definition.proposition: At 200M tokens of code-py-v2 and matched training FLOPs (~0.19 GFLOP/token), the assembled recipe A2s (GDN hybrid, shared core of 6 blocks x 2 passes with fixed r and full backprop, ternary core with full-precision prelude/coda/inject, contractive injection) beats the naive full fusion E27 by about 17% in clean80 bpc.

scope.dataset: code-py-v2, clean80 doc-level bpc (v1 val, K9 overlap < 0.8)

definition.refutation_criteria: REFUTED if a replication on fresh seeds or a longer horizon (SQ380) puts the paired 95% CI of A2s - E27 at or above -5%

reason: A2 P1 (registered before dispatch): A2s - E27 = -16.67%, paired 95% CI [-17.74%, -15.58%], df 2, per seed -17.05 / -16.12 / -16.82 (seeds 2-4, fresh; never used for A1 selection). Prediction -17% (range -25% to -10%): in range. Secondary: A2s vs E20 +8.58% [+8.05, +9.11]; full-precision A2f vs E20 -0.86% (n 3); A2f vs E24 +3.21% [+2.00, +4.44].

verified_at.basis: HEAD of the checkout when the event was recorded

limitations.text: Recipe-level claim only: the A1 one-change effects behind the stack are exploratory (2 seeds) and confounded inside it; A2f/E24 shows the assembled loop model still trails an unshared GDN stack at matched FLOPs by 3.2%. Single horizon (200M; SQ380 tests 600M) and in-corpus clean80 only (SQ379 out of corpus). E27's real training compute is 11% below its counted FLOPs (truncated BPTT, v0.5.3); A2s trains every pass with gradients, so the comparison slightly favours A2s on compute.
